connector.name: Seam Runtime
connector.registryDescription: SEAM: local-first memory runtime for AI agents, with retrieval and glassbox provenance over MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package seam-runtime. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the blackhatshiftey account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SEAM_DB_PATH
env.description: Path to the local SQLite memory database. Defaults to a per-user data directory if unset.

env.name: SEAM_PGVECTOR_DSN
env.description: Optional Postgres/pgvector DSN for the vector adapter. If unset, SEAM runs on the built-in SQLite vector store.
